AHD is good for quality, but they go for quality over variety. I like some old movies that aren't released in HD, and thus are not on AHD. TehC has a wider selection of movies - unless you have really, really niche tastes, you'll probably find some encode on TehC.

However TehC goes for availability over quality, and they also limit each type of encode (only one 1080p, for example). This is fine but their trumping rules aren't that clear-cut so ultimately the encode on TehC is't always the best (it's usually a scene encode).

Ultimately what turns me off is the "seeding average" policy though, it's almost like a seedbonus policy without actually giving you a seed bonus. I don't mind seeding (duh), but TehC's way of requiring you to do so to advance userclasses makes me feel like I'm being forced to seed, and for no return. It's a petty feeling, I know, but I don't see why they can't just implement seedbonus like everyone else.

Because of that TehC is my backup tracker when all else fails and I can't find an encode. If I can't find an encode on AHD it's usually a rare movie that's only in SD, and obscure movies with less than 5 seeders are freeleech in TehC. So I treat TehC as a last-resort, ratioless tracker - the stuff I get from there is usually freeleech and I just seed till HnR. I have a very low userclass/uploads/downloads there but I'm totally fine with that.
